proposal.name: Keep closing commands in shortened comments

plan.name: Keep closing commands in shortened comments
plan.summary: Each factory post supplies its closing instructions separately from its body through post(title, body, marker, closing...), with optional closing text including its original separating whitespace; omitted closing text means no instructions, and no body text is searched for commands. Migrate all instruction-bearing callers and forwarding helpers, including notes and stopped-build guidance, preserving the caller's complete wording, arguments, ratification hash and line breaks for ratify, revise, choose, retry, stop and any other command it asks a person to comment. Reserve space for that exact closing text alongside the unchanged marker, byline and existing omission notice, still dropping collapsed body details before clipping other body text within the existing size budget and keeping valid UTF-8, with the omission notice after the closing text. Posts that already fit, and shortening posts without closing instructions, keep their current output; acceptance retains the large compressed test-source marker, other commands and short-post cases, and adds regressions for diagnostic quotes and wrapped instructions. Whoever merges records the previously unrecorded two-way decision to preserve explicit caller-supplied closing instructions when shortening comments; SPEC.md and README.md remain accurate.

tests.name: TestClippedPlanKeepsRatificationInstructions
tests.says: A proposal whose marker leaves too little room for its acceptance-test table still displays its complete ratify instruction with the correct hash and its revise instruction, retains its marker and byline, and reports omitted detail; a short post stays byte-for-byte unchanged.

tests.name: TestClippedPostsKeepClosingCommands
tests.says: Shortening posts preserves complete choose, revise, retry and stop instructions, including multiple closing lines and instructions sharing a line with long prose, while retaining valid UTF-8, the marker, the omission notice, details-first reduction and the existing output for posts without commands.

tests.name: TestPostsKeepOnlyExplicitClosingInstructions
tests.says: Closing instructions supplied separately to post remain whole, including their opening words across line breaks and commands it has never seen; diagnostic quotes of commands in a body with no supplied instructions retain the exact existing short or clipped output, and quoted diagnostics are not promoted when genuine instructions are supplied.

usage.summary: Revised [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-3932321678/plan.json) to preserve explicitly supplied closing instructions, adding regressions for wrapped instructions and diagnostic quotes. The check passed: all three acceptance tests fail on the base code, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
